title: EZ Timer
description: Very easy to use timer. Start, pause and reset is all you really need. | Using FuseBox API
body:
![Banner that shows that this datapack uses FuseBox for the backend.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0973c880b001e8bec5ef72e7f7ace14311dbbd84.png)
As FuseBox still is in early development, it currently is directly implemented into this pack. This may change in the future. FuseBox serves as the backend for this pack.
# EZ Timer
This is the easiest-to-use timer available. When opening the world with this pack enabled for the first time, a paused timer will appear in everyones actionbar.
There are 3 actions you can take:

To **start** the timer:

```
/trigger start
```

To **pause** the timer:

```
/trigger pause
```

To **reset** the timer:

```
/trigger reset
```

---

It's as easy as that!

---
